FOCOM_AUTO_REGISTER_RESOURCE_TYPES: `true`, `1` or `yes`: `POST /resources/provision` registers an unknown `resourceTypeId` in FOCOM's own resource types (named by its id) instead of refusing it with 404 `RESOURCE_TYPE_NOT_FOUND`. Off by default; nothing is called.
FOCOM_IMS_ENDPOINT: Path FOCOM advertises as the O2ims `infrastructureManagementServicesEndPoint` in an O-Cloud's registration. Change it when FOCOM is published under another path.
FOCOM_SMO_REGISTRATION_SERVICE: URL FOCOM advertises as the O2ims `smoRegistrationService` (where an O-Cloud registers with the SMO). Set it to the address the O-Cloud can reach R1 Termination at.
